h1: Custom Koozie Business Cards for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Koozie Business Cards – Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom koozie business cards from Perfect Imprints. Durable, printed with your logo. Great for trade shows and promotions.
introHtml: Koozie business cards combine the practicality of a drink insulator with the essential contact information your prospects need. Made from durable neoprene, these custom koozie business cards are a memorable alternative to paper cards. They hold up to spills and frequent handling, making them ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, and bar promotions. Choose full-color imprinting to showcase your logo, tagline, or contact details on both sides. Each card fits standard cans and bottles, ensuring your brand stays visible long after the event ends.
heroAltText: Custom koozie business card with full-color logo imprint on neoprene, held next to a beverage can
